4353.title: Reconnect submission gating
4353.rootCauseOneLine: Queue mode selects a steering primary action even when reconnect runtime states cannot steer.
4353.proposedFix: Retain a queue submission path and notify host-thread runtime changes on reconnect.
4353.caveats: Composer logic reproduced twice; live reconnect persistence and browser keyboard behavior were not exercised. Full fix crosses subsystems.
